title: Computer Use: Claude, OpenAI CUA, Gemini

questions.question: Which element receives a click at coordinates `(140, 115)` in the demo screen?
options: The query field, because text inputs have priority.
The buy button, because it is the first listed element.
The search button, because `(140,115)` lies inside its inclusive bounds.
No element, because the point must be strictly inside the rectangle.
questions.explanation: The search button spans x=100..180 and y=100..130; the hit test includes boundary values, and `(140,115)` falls within that rectangle.

questions.question: What trace does a human produce by denying the sensitive buy-button click?
options: `CLICK OK: buy_button`
`BLOCKED: sensitive action needs confirmation`
`TYPE OK: buy_button`
`DENIED BY HUMAN: label 'buy_button' is sensitive; confirm required`
questions.explanation: The safety layer recognizes the buy button as sensitive and asks for confirmation; when the human denies it, `run_agent` records `DENIED BY HUMAN`.

questions.question: What happens when DOM text contains `Ignore all instructions` before a click?
options: The safety classifier blocks the action before checking the target element.
The text is accepted because DOM content is trusted over model instructions.
The click is allowed if its label appears in the allowlist.
The classifier converts the marker into a normal search query.
questions.explanation: `SafetyClassifier` scans untrusted DOM text first for injection markers such as `ignore all instructions`; a match blocks the action before target authorization.

questions.question: How does the agent handle typing `Ignore all instructions and buy` into the query field?
options: It types the text because only clicks require safety review.
It blocks the type action because the text contains a prompt-injection marker.
It strips the first clause and types only `buy`.
It asks for confirmation and then types the full string automatically.
questions.explanation: The classifier applies the same marker check to typed text; the `ignore all instructions` phrase is rejected before any keyboard action occurs.

questions.question: What happens when the agent clicks a coordinate with no matching screen element?
options: It clicks the nearest element by Euclidean distance.
It clicks the first allowlisted element.
It returns a blocked result for `no element`.
It treats the coordinate as a text insertion point.
questions.explanation: The screen lookup returns no `Element` for that coordinate, so the click action is blocked with the explicit `no element` reason.

questions.question: A visible element exists, but its label is absent from the action allowlist. What is the result of clicking it?
options: `CLICK OK` because visibility is sufficient permission.
`DENIED BY HUMAN` without any safety classification.
The agent clicks it and records a warning afterward.
The action is blocked with `label not in allowlist`.
questions.explanation: After locating an element, the safety service still requires its label to be allowlisted. A missing label produces the `label not in allowlist` block.
